decisions.reason: As a newly launched but publicly listed floor-care complement, it is likely to be retained because the firm has already committed to the range and can still view any weak uptake as temporary.

Maintenance oil fits closely with wood-floor aftercare, and an established German wood-products firm would tend to persist with such a complementary item after launch rather than reverse course quickly.
Although easier to discontinue than a core flooring product, it supports the firm's broader wood-floor system offer and escalation of commitment makes an early withdrawal unlikely.
The underlay with moisture protection is closely tied to flooring installation, so prior launch effort and visible market commitment favor keeping it on the market.
This product is part of the installation portfolio around floors, and management is likely to continue backing it because the launch is recent and results can still be attributed to market-building.
An oak parquet floor is highly central to the firm's core business and likely required the most investment, making it the least likely product to be withdrawn within a year.
